meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Emacs 直连 AI 助手,对话无需离开编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果离不开 Emacs,想在编辑器里随时向 AI 提问。
copy.tagline_en: Chat with your AI assistant right inside Emacs without switching tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you live in Emacs and want AI help without leaving your editor.

howto.what: 在 Emacs 里再加一个和 NanoClaw 对话的入口:打开聊天 buffer 就能提问,或用 org 发送命令把当前标题或选区发给它,回复会作为子标题直接落在 org 文件里。支持 Doom、Spacemacs 和原生 Emacs 27.1+。
howto.when: 当 NanoClaw 已启用 Emacs 频道并在你的 Emacs 配置里加载 nanoclaw.el 后,你在 Emacs 中打开聊天 buffer,或对某个 org 标题发送内容时触发。

say.text: 解释一下我光标下这个函数的用途
say.note: 在聊天 buffer 里直接提问

say.text: 把这段选中的代码发过去做代码审查
say.note: 回复会以子标题形式写入 org 文件

say.text: 给这个会议记录标题生成行动项清单
say.note: 对 org 标题发送内容后等待回复

howto.what_en: Adds an Emacs entry point to NanoClaw: open a chat buffer to ask questions, or send the current org heading or region; replies land as a child heading in your org file. Works with Doom, Spacemacs, and vanilla Emacs 27.1+.
howto.when_en: Triggers once the Emacs channel is enabled and nanoclaw.el is loaded in your config, when you open the chat buffer in Emacs or send an org heading's content.

say_en.text: Explain what the function under my cursor does
say_en.note: Ask directly in the chat buffer

say_en.text: Send this selected code for a code review
say_en.note: Reply arrives as a child heading in org

say_en.text: Generate an action item list for this meeting heading
say_en.note: Send an org heading and wait for the reply
